measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hgrunt.mdl, models/barney.mdl, models/hassassin.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked B, D, D, A where the asset was B, D, D, B: told apart
measured.lineupWhy:
1. Its head is an oversized, rounded shape wrapped in tan and brown stripes, while the other three have heads sized to normal Half-Life human proportions.
2. Its white coat is frayed and tattered with dark patches, where the other three have clean, solid fabric and paint.
3. Its arm carries a long, blade-like protrusion that sticks out at an odd angle, and the figure stoops forward, unlike the upright stance of the other three.
